featured_reviews.name: Viraj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had a really positive experience at this gym. The equipment is excellent, with a great variety for both weight training and cardio, so it’s easy to keep workouts effective and interesting. The staff are always helpful and approachable, and one of the biggest advantages is that it never feels too crowded, which makes it much easier to stay consistent and focused during sessions.

A special thanks to my personal trainer, Yogesh Pednekar, who has made a huge difference in my fitness journey. His guidance, motivation, and personalized approach have helped me build strength and lose weight in a sustainable way. He’s not just knowledgeable but also incredibly inspiring, always pushing me to do better while keeping workouts engaging and achievable.

I Definitely recommend to join this gym and take personal training from Yogesh

featured_reviews.name: Pranali Warang
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a member of One Above Borivali for over three years, and it’s been a consistently great experience. The gym is well-equipped with high-quality machines that I haven’t found elsewhere, and the staff is always friendly and supportive. The overall crowd is also very positive and motivating.

I usually workout after office hours and the welcoming environment makes it easy to stay consistent. Overall, it’s been a wonderful experience, and I plan to continue here. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a gym with excellent equipment, great ambience, and a motivating crowd.

featured_reviews.name: Harshana Ganatra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been working out at one above fitness but this is the first time I opted for person training from Arun sir. His workout style is very unique, no two sessions ever feel the same, and he constantly introduces new movements and techniques that keep things fresh and challenging.
What I appreciate most is how engaging every session is. I never find myself watching the clock. He keeps the energy high, corrects my form carefully, and pushes me just enough to improve without feeling overwhelmed.
Since training with him, my body feels noticeably stronger, more balanced, and more capable overall. I actually look forward to coming to the gym every day now, which is something I never thought I’d say!
If you’re looking for a trainer who makes workouts effective, motivating, and genuinely enjoyable, I highly recommend him.

featured_reviews.name: Ankita Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been going to this gym for over a year now, and for the first time ever, I have actually stayed consistent—and a huge part of that is thanks to my trainer Dinesh K.

Dinesh constantly motivates me to show up, even on days when I feel like skipping. He always pushes me to go that extra mile (or rep!) that I wouldn’t do on my own.

The gym itself is top-notch—great equipment, clean environment, and an overall vibe that makes you want to come back every day.

Highly recommended 👍

featured_reviews.name: Manisha Dashpatnaik
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great experience at One Above—clean, well-maintained, and motivating environment. Friendly and well-behaved staff, with special mention to Purvi, Nitin, and Sheetal for being helpful and welcoming.
I’m truly grateful to my personal trainer, Yogesh Sir, for supporting me through a very challenging phase since August 2025. I joined 6 months ago with a fragile body and mind, unsure if I could continue, but his guidance made all the difference. Yogesh Sir is very knowledgeable, understands my health concerns, plans safe workouts, and also guides me on my daily food intake.With his focus on slow, steady progress and constant motivation, I’ve become stronger, healthier, and have lost almost 7 kgs. I feel lighter, more active, and much more confident.Looking forward to continuing my training with him and building an even stronger mind and body. Highly recommend Yogesh Sir and One Above.💫

featured_reviews.name: Afreen Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: As a complete beginner who was totally new to working out, I couldn't have asked for a better trainer than Deepak Ray. He is the definition of professional—always prepared, focused on safety, and punctual. What truly made my experience amazing, though, was his incredible patience and kindness. He took the time to break down every movement, making sure I understood and felt comfortable. He is so knowledgeable, and he built a solid, non-intimidating foundation for me. If you’re a first-timer, ask for Deepak! Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Sumati Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined gym last month as simple walking as an exercise in Borivali is not easy. This gym is very well equipped, all the machines are bought from Germany, uk, USA and their maintenance is superb.
The atmosphere is very friendly, the personal trainers are very helpfull. I was lucky to have Mr. Arun Mayekar sir as my instructor. He knows his subject so well, considering each member's physical strength, age, physic he gets the workout done from you. He also explains the pros and cons, which muscles get trained, what actions you should avoid and what precautions one must take. So all in all I am happy that I joined this gym.
The whole staff is very polite and is ready and willing  to help you.
I will strongly recommend to join this gym.

featured_reviews.name: Sweetz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Joined this gym in Aug 2025 just thinking “cardio toh kar hi sakti hoon” 😄With plantar fasciitis + bunion, I was like bas treadmill pe walk karke ghar jao.

But this gym? Clean, spacious, amazing machines, and such a good vibe ✨

And then enters Yogesh Pednekar Sir 😄Smiling face, sharp eyes ,handsome, toned body, noticed I was doing ONLY cardio and probably judged me silently 😂He was like “you need to prioritise your health”… and I was like “sir let me survive cardio first” 😅

But this man did not give up.Slowly tested my endurance, pushed me (thoda forcefully also 😄), and made me believe I could actually lift weights.

Today  April  2026, from avoiding dumbbells to actually lifting them… with plantar and bunion still there but fear gone 💪All thanks to him constantly saying “trust the process” (even when I clearly didn’t 🤪)

What makes him diffrent?? He doesn’t just train, he cares about your pain, your progress, and even your mood.Somehow manages to be strict + supportive + motivating all at once. On days I doubted myself, he believed for me. On days I felt pain, he stood right there making sure I didn’t quit.

Thank you Yogesh Sir for not giving up on me when I had already decided “yeh nahi hoga” 😄thank you for being my coach ,my support system  and honestly the reason I kept showing .If he’s your trainer, just know you can’t escape workouts… but you WILL see results 🙌 and you are already halfway through.
